It also matches the dataset‑wide trend that median strategies perform well on similar series. The dba strategy (C) has a lower mean score but exhibits a large outlier in the second window (1.10), indicating sensitivity to a single window and higher variance in weight estimation. The pruned‑pool median (A) has a higher outlier (1.85) and a slightly worse overall score. Thus B provides the best balance of stability and performance for this series.
loop.top3_why_not: A has a higher per‑window outlier (1.85) and a slightly worse overall score, making it less stable. C, while having the lowest mean validation score, shows a pronounced spike in the second window (1.10), suggesting it may overfit to a particular window and be less reliable for the blind test. Therefore, B is the preferred choice.
